rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a church bishop.

example.english: The bishop will lead Mass tomorrow.
example.traditional: 嗰位主教聽日會主持彌撒。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 zyu2 gaau3 ting1 jat6 wui5 zyu2 ci4 mei4 saat3

rows.note: Use this as the usual spoken name for a bishop in chess, rather than 主教.

example.english: Be careful with this move—the opponent's bishop is about to take your rook.
example.traditional: 呢步要小心，對面隻象就快食到你隻車喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 deoi3 min6 zek3 zoeng6 zau6 faai3 sik6 dou3 nei5 zek3 ce1 laa3

rows.note: Use this alternative chess term when the 相 naming convention is being used.

example.english: Your bishop is too far forward and can easily be captured.
example.traditional: 你隻相擺得太前，容易畀人食。
example.jyutping: nei5 zek3 soeng3 baai2 dak1 taai3 cin4 jung4 ji6 bei2 jan4 sik6
